title: Optimal bounds for the length of rational Collatz cycles
notes: Acta Arithmetica 78 (1997) 227-239. Defines the word-dependent quantity phi(s) from the affine Collatz iterate, then optimizes it over cyclic shifts. The optimal criterion is costly to check. The Juggler analogue is the slack-weight vector alpha_i(w)=2^i 3^{o_{>i}} and S(w)=sum alpha; there is no affine closed form. Cited from docs/problems/juggler_cycle_word_functional.md.
